title: Ninth Word Fifth Point Testimony And The Result Of The Sunset Prayer

questions.question: In this part, what two big truths does a person say after sitting in the prayer?
questions.answer: That Allah is One and that Muhammad, peace be upon him, is Allah’s Messenger.

questions.question: What gift does the person offer while sitting in the prayer?
questions.answer: He offers blessed greetings and good prayers.

questions.question: Who is greeted in this part of the prayer?
questions.answer: Allah’s noble Messenger, peace be upon him.

questions.question: When the person greets the Messenger, what does he make strong again in his heart?
questions.answer: His loyalty and obedience.

questions.question: What does the person look at in the universe to make his faith bright again?
questions.answer: The wise order in the universe.

questions.question: Seeing the good order in the universe helps the person know what about Allah?
questions.answer: That Allah is One.

questions.question: What does the person say about Prophet Muhammad’s job?
questions.answer: He tells about Allah’s rule, teaches what pleases Allah, and explains Allah’s signs.

questions.question: Why is the sunset prayer described as something more than just movements?
questions.answer: Because it is worship, service, a serious duty, and a happy meeting with Allah.

questions.question: What kind of place is this world called in the passage?
questions.answer: A temporary guesthouse.

questions.question: After sitting in the sunset prayer, what does the worshipper say about Allah?
questions.answer: He says Allah has no partner and is the only God.

questions.question: What does the worshipper say about Muhammad, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: He says Muhammad is Allah’s Prophet.

questions.question: Are the greetings offered only for other people, or also from the person himself?
questions.answer: Also from the person himself.

questions.question: What does greeting the Messenger show about how a Muslim should act?
questions.answer: A Muslim should follow and obey him.

questions.question: What in the universe helps the worshipper refresh his belief?
questions.answer: Its orderly and wise design.

questions.question: If the universe is arranged with wisdom, what does that point to?
questions.answer: It points to one glorious Creator.

questions.question: How is Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, described in relation to Allah’s signs?
questions.answer: He explains them to people.

questions.question: Why does the passage say a real human should understand the sunset prayer?
questions.answer: Because it is a beautiful, pure, and important act of worship.

questions.question: What feeling does the passage connect with this prayer: emptiness or happiness?
questions.answer: Happiness.

questions.question: Is the happiness from this prayer short or lasting?
questions.answer: Lasting.

questions.question: What does the person bear witness to while sitting in the prayer?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness and Muhammad’s prophethood.

questions.question: What does the person do after greeting the Messenger, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: He renews his promise to follow him.

questions.question: What does “renewing belief” mean here in a simple way?
questions.answer: Making faith strong and fresh again.

questions.question: What does the person notice in the universe that helps do that?
questions.answer: Its careful order and wisdom.

questions.question: What does this order show about the Maker?
questions.answer: That the Maker is One.

questions.question: What are two things the Prophet, peace be upon him, does in this passage?
questions.answer: He announces what Allah wants and explains the signs in creation.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the sunset prayer as a duty?
questions.answer: As noble, clean, and beautiful.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the sunset prayer as an experience with Allah?
questions.answer: As an ongoing conversation and lasting joy.

questions.question: Why does the passage call the world a guesthouse?
questions.answer: Because people stay here only for a short time.

questions.question: In this passage, what statement about Allah comes before the statement about the Prophet?
questions.answer: The statement that Allah is One.

questions.question: What statement about the Prophet comes in the prayer?
questions.answer: That Muhammad, peace be upon him, is Allah’s Messenger.

questions.question: While sitting, what does the worshipper send as a present in worship?
questions.answer: Greetings and blessings.

questions.question: Why does the worshipper greet the Messenger in the prayer?
questions.answer: To show love, loyalty, and obedience.

questions.question: What does the worshipper study in the universe to strengthen faith?
questions.answer: The wise pattern and order in it.

questions.question: What does the wise pattern of the universe help prove?
questions.answer: The unity of the Creator.

questions.question: How is Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, connected to the “book” of the universe?
questions.answer: He explains its signs and meanings.

questions.question: According to the passage, is the sunset prayer small and unimportant, or high and serious?
questions.answer: High and serious.

questions.question: What does the passage say this prayer can become for a person in this temporary world?
questions.answer: A pleasing worship and a lasting happiness.

questions.question: What two testimonies are made in this part of the prayer?
questions.answer: That Allah is One and that Muhammad, peace be upon him, is His Messenger.

questions.question: In this sitting, are the offered blessings small or special?
questions.answer: Special and blessed.

questions.question: For whose sake does the person offer these greetings?
questions.answer: On his own behalf to Allah.

questions.question: What happens to the person’s bond with the Prophet, peace be upon him, when he greets him?
questions.answer: It is renewed.

questions.question: What else is renewed and made brighter in the person?
questions.answer: His faith.

questions.question: What helps make faith brighter?
questions.answer: Looking at the universe’s wise order.

questions.question: What title in the passage best fits Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him: builder, herald, or trader?
questions.answer: Herald.

questions.question: What does he herald and explain?
questions.answer: Allah’s rule and the signs in creation.

questions.question: What words best match the passage’s view of the sunset prayer: boring and heavy, or lovely and joyful?
questions.answer: Lovely and joyful.

questions.question: What kind of happiness is linked to this prayer?
questions.answer: Happiness that continues.

questions.question: When the person sits in the prayer, what does he confirm about Allah and His Messenger?
questions.answer: He confirms Allah’s oneness and Muhammad’s prophethood.

questions.question: What does he offer to Allah from himself at that time?
questions.answer: Salutations and blessings.

questions.question: What does greeting the Messenger, peace be upon him, show about the worshipper’s choices?
questions.answer: That he chooses to follow and obey the Messenger.

questions.question: To make belief fresh again, where does the worshipper look?
questions.answer: At the universe.

questions.question: What does he see there?
questions.answer: A wise and orderly system.

questions.question: What truth does that system lead him to say?
questions.answer: That the Maker is One.

questions.question: What three roles of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, are mentioned?
questions.answer: He announces Allah’s dominion, tells what pleases Allah, and explains the signs of creation.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the sunset prayer’s value?
questions.answer: It is noble, pleasing, and very important.

questions.question: Why does the passage join this prayer with permanent happiness instead of temporary fun?
questions.answer: Because the world is temporary, but nearness to Allah lasts.
